question: How many para-athletes were honoured with the Arjuna Award in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**17**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **January 2025**, the **President of India** conferred the **National Sports Awards 2024** at a specially organized ceremony at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• A record-breaking number of **17 para-athletes** were honored with the **Arjuna Award** for their exceptional performance, primarily focusing on their achievements at the **Paris 2024 Paralympic Games**.
 
• The decision to award such a high number of para-athletes reflects India's historic success at the **Paris Paralympics**, where the nation secured a total of **29 medals**, including **7 Gold**, **9 Silver**, and **13 Bronze**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** announced these awards based on the recommendations of a high-level **Selection Committee** consisting of former Olympians and sportspersons.
 
• This recognition aims to boost the morale of **Para-sports** in India and provide social security and institutional support to athletes with disabilities who have brought international laurels to the **country**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjuna Award for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games:**

 
 
• It was instituted in the year **1961** by the **Government of India** to recognize outstanding achievement in National sports.
 
• The award is given to sportspersons for "good performance over a period of **four years**" at the international level and for showing qualities of **leadership, sportsmanship, and a sense of discipline**.
 
• The award carries a cash prize of **Rs 15 lakh**, a bronze **statuette of Arjuna**, and a scroll of honor.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Awards Categories:**
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:** The highest sporting honor of **India**, awarded for the most spectacular and outstanding performance by a sportsperson over a period of **four years**.
 
• **Dronacharya Award:** Instituted in **1985**, this is presented to **coaches** for producing medal winners at prestigious international sports events.
 
• **Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement:** Honoring sportspersons who have contributed to sports by their performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports even after retirement.
 
 
 
• **Paris 2024 Paralympic Context:**
 
 
• India's performance in **2024** was its best-ever in the history of the **Paralympic Games**, surpassing the **19 medals** won at the **Tokyo 2020** Paralympics.
 
• Key disciplines where the **17 para-athletes** excelled include **Para-Athletics, Para-Badminton, Para-Archery, and Para-Shooting**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:** The applications for the awards are invited **online**, and sportspersons are permitted to self-nominate. The **Selection Committee** is usually headed by a retired **Supreme Court or High Court Judge**.
 
• **MAKA Trophy:** The **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy** is also part of these awards, given to the overall top-performing **university** in inter-university tournaments.
 
• **Incentives:** Apart from the cash prize, **Arjuna Awardees** are eligible for various **government schemes**, including pension for life after retirement from active sports and concession in **Railway travel**.
